svg.aria-label: Across the product, beyond the interface. Toolkit: Mobile: Flutter, React Native; Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript; Backend: Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis; Cloud: AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Sentry; AI: Gemini, Claude, OpenAI; Growth: AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Google Ads, PostHog, GoHighLevel. Principles: Field apps work with no signal, and every record reaches the office. Measure the slow screen, then fix the query, not the spinner. Decisions live next to the code: comments, lint rules, tests.
